verdict.rationale: Capacities offers a documented Full Export feature (manual and scheduled) that outputs Markdown with front-matter properties and CSV collections, explicitly described as 'fully human- and machine-readable' and easy to reuse in other apps or programmatically, which directly satisfies the open-format export need for switchers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of export fidelity/completeness and confirmation of full round-trip re-import elsewhere.
